decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster fits the firm's core coolant management portfolio and costs little to keep listed, and its value has not yet been disproven, so keeping the option open is justified.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge supports the firm's filtration and sustainability positioning, and two years of continued presence with no negative signals argue for holding the option while demand resolves.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a staple of the metalworking conveyor line, with low marginal cost and steady demand, so dropping this option makes no sense.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are a core, widely demanded conveyor type that complements the remaining range after the magnetic conveyor was removed, so the product stays.
